title: Calling Functions
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of calling functions.

Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces calling functions as part of python functions. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: A good function has a clear contract: inputs, output, side effects, and failure behavior. Keep one responsibility in each function and test important edge cases.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A function groups reusable behavior behind parameters and an optional return value.

content_blocks.code:
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    """Return a short greeting."""
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

print(greet("Ari"))
content_blocks.run_instructions: Run with python main.py. Change the argument and explain what the return value represents.
